news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 2.5x This is considered a major risk. If the company is unable to fund interest repayments on its debt through profits, it may be forced into reducing its debt burden through selling assets, undertaking a potentially costly capital raising or even into bankruptcy in the worst case scenario. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.76 (vs ₹1.54 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.76 (up from ₹1.54 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹35.4b (up 59% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹937.1m (up 333% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.6% (up from 1.0% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 7.2% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹3.05 loss per share (vs ₹0.92 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹3.05 loss per share (down from ₹0.92 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹5.36b (down 10% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹627.8m (down ₹757.4m from profit in 3Q 2025).

news.title: Kalpataru Limited Appoints Gajendra Mewara as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective February 6, 2026
news.body: Kalpataru Limited has appointed Mr. Gajendra Mewara (ICSI Membership No. A22941) as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company and designated him as a Key Managerial Personnel (“KMP”) with effect from February 6, 2026. Mr. Gajendra Mewara is a qualified Company Secretary and Law Graduate with over 18 years of extensive experience in corporate secretarial functions, board processes, corporate governance and compliance management across diverse sectors, including healthcare, automobile, infrastructure, insurance, and real estate. He has handled key assignments viz. IPO, QIP, mergers and amalgamations, private equity transactions, setting up compliance management framework and implementation of good corporate governance practices across various organisations.
